sourceV3.V3_AI_Evidence_Note: Retain LTPP SDR39 documentation assignments from the version 2.0 report and FHWA primary-source packet. A selected engineering-data cohort and payload/linkage tests are still required. The portal reports 2,581 sections; this is a database-wide count, not a selected modeling cohort. Database schema, survey processes and quality-level documentation support L1–L4 and D1–D5 for engineering tables. Section IDs and acquisition groups support C1/C3, while sensor/record schema and processing support M1/M2/M3/M5. Defined measured IRI/condition/treatment records support E1/E2. Image-level quality checks cannot be inherited from PPDB table status. Select compatible observation times, survey status and held-out sections before E3 or G4 can pass.
